topics.title: Nvidia board weighs replacing CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal
topics.explanation: Nvidia's board of directors is evaluating potential replacements for CEO Jensen Huang following reports of extramarital affairs, including one involving a woman suspected of spying for China. The board has engaged an outside firm to assist with executive search efforts while lawmakers raise national security questions. The uncertainty surrounding Huang's status has pressured Nvidia shares and weighed on broader tech futures.
topics.why_it_matters: Executive turnover at a dominant chipmaker can trigger significant stock price volatility and impact the wider tech ecosystem.

topics.title: CoreWeave stock rallies after beating third-quarter revenue expectations
topics.explanation: CoreWeave posted third-quarter financial results that topped revenue estimates and allowed the company to raise its full-year guidance. To finance its continuing artificial intelligence expansion, the firm is relying on customer prepayments, shorter contracts, and contract-backed borrowing. Following the earnings report, Chief Executive Officer Mike Intrator announced the cancellation of his planned share sale program.
topics.why_it_matters: Strong earnings from specialized cloud providers signal ongoing demand for artificial intelligence hardware and infrastructure.

topics.title: Drone developer Uforce reaches $6 billion valuation in funding round
topics.explanation: Defense technology startup Uforce achieved a $6 billion valuation after closing a $700 million financing round. The investment round included backing from the UK National Wealth Fund, marking its largest commitment to a defense company. Uforce manufactures combat drones and naval defense vessels originally developed in Ukraine.
topics.why_it_matters: Substantial capital raises for military tech startups highlight growing investor confidence in battle-proven defense hardware.

topics.title: Meta infrastructure chief Santosh Janardhan to step down
topics.explanation: Meta announced that its longtime head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering, Santosh Janardhan, will step down from his position. Former Amazon Web Services executive David Brown will take over the infrastructure division. Janardhan originally joined Meta in 2009 before taking on senior engineering management duties.
topics.why_it_matters: Leadership transitions in tech infrastructure can affect how major platforms build out their data center capacity.

topics.title: Investors examine India as an emerging market alternative to AI tech stocks
topics.explanation: Market strategists are discussing whether India can draw global capital as high-flying artificial intelligence trades experience increased volatility. Top asset managers noted that while the AI boom previously drew capital away from emerging markets, India offers a potential alternative for international investors. The discussions focus on how capital allocation may shift if tech sector momentum cools.
topics.why_it_matters: Shifts in investor sentiment can reallocate global funds away from overheated tech sectors and into emerging regional markets.
